title.zh: 宣布每年 9 月 1 日为布基农省特别非工作假日（名称为Araw Ng Bukidnon）的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring September 1 of Every Year A Special Non-working Holiday in the Province of Bukidnon To Be Known As “Araw Ng Bukidnon”, in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring September 1 of Every Year A Special Non-working Holiday in the Province of Bukidnon To Be Known As “Araw Ng Bukidnon”, in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 1 tháng 9 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Bukidnon với tên gọi "Araw Ng Bukidnon", nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 1 กันยายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในจังหวัด Bukidnon ในชื่อ "Araw Ng Bukidnon" เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 1 September setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Provinsi Bukidnon dengan nama "Araw Ng Bukidnon", dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 1 September setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Wilayah Bukidnon dengan nama "Araw Ng Bukidnon", sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12039_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: September 1 of every year is hereby declared a special non-working holiday in the Province of Bukidnon, to be known as "Araw ng Bukidnon", in commemoration of its foundation anniversary.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
